set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
universe u
open CategoryTheory
open scoped AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace Adelic
variable (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]

-- JOINT NON-VACUITY TEST: derive a FALSE statement from the binder set alone.
-- If the set were unsatisfiable, `False` would be provable from it.
-- Instead check a positive consequence that would be absurd if the set were empty:
-- the file already proves things about P.point; check the curve has SOME prime divisor
-- is NOT forced, but that the hypotheses do not collapse the scheme to a point.

-- Concretely: the hypotheses imply coheight <= 1 AND PrimeDivisor has coheight = 1.
-- So a PrimeDivisor exists only if the curve is not a point -- consistent, not vacuous.
example (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsIntegral C.left] [IsLocallyNoetherian C.left]
    [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne C.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    (P : C.left.PrimeDivisor) : Order.coheight P.point = 1 := P.coheight

-- And that the point is genuinely closed and distinct from the generic point.
example (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsIntegral C.left] [IsLocallyNoetherian C.left]
    [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne C.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    (P : C.left.PrimeDivisor) : P.point ≠ genericPoint C.left := by
  intro h
  have hmax : IsMax (genericPoint C.left) := fun y hy => genericPoint_specializes y
  have h0 : Order.coheight P.point = 0 := by
    rw [h]; exact Order.IsMax.coheight_eq_zero hmax
  rw [P.coheight] at h0
  exact absurd h0 (by simp)

end Adelic
end AlgebraicGeometry
EOF
